### Multi-capability DMS at the core

At the core of Doxis is a powerful, highly scalable [document management system](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/document-management) designed to free your team from the chaos of content located across multiple, scattered systems.

- Instantly [find and manage documents](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/document-management) across all business applications.
- [Automate workflows](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/process-automation) like approvals, recruitment and invoicing.
- Tap into [AI](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/content-understanding) that goes beyond automation, processing documents intelligently and guiding you with real insights.

[Read more →](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/document-management)

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/redesign/images/backgrounds/document-management-animated.svg)

### AI that understands your content

Built into the DMS is sophisticated AI that understands your documents, can answer questions and extract valuable insights for better decision-making.

- Extracts, validates and understands information from critical documents.
- Reviews documents for compliance risks and highlights key changes.
- Always uses the latest, most secure AI models, tailored to your business needs.

[Read more →](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/content-understanding)

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/redesign/images/backgrounds/artificial-Intelligence-animated.svg)

### State-of-the-art solutions

Managing complex processes across departments is challenging — our cloud solutions empower your teams to work smarter with fast, flexible tools.

- Solutions for HR, sales, purchase-to-pay processes and more available in the cloud and on-prem.
- Fast starters: a library of content apps for various horizontal and vertical use cases.
- Work securely and effortlessly from anywhere, anytime, on any device.

Siloed systems hinder efficiency. Our seamless integrations unify data across platforms, enabling end-to-end automation.

- Integrates seamlessly with applications like [SAP](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap/dms-for-sap), [Salesforce](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/salesforce), [Microsoft](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/microsoft-365) and [more](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/business-connectors).

## One platform powering your entire document lifecycle

With our holistic **Document Intelligence** approach, Doxis Intelligent Content Automation brings the entire document lifecycle together on **one platform**, capturing and processing documents from intake to archive. It turns scattered content into structured knowledge and connects it to the processes that run your business. Get ready to **boost productivity** and **act with greater clarity**.

## Accelerate & automate content-centric workflows

Once captured, Doxis turns your documents into accessible, actionable assets and routes them to digital workflows or third-party systems, while tracking every step for compliance and transparency.

- Eliminate time-consuming searches for documents and information.
- Automate approvals, delegations and multi-stage workflows across Doxis and connected applications.
- Simplify documentation and compliance management with data delivered where it’s needed.

## AI that understands your business & empowers teams

Powering Doxis’ capabilities, our AI works in the background to capture key information from documents and connect it to the right processes. Specialized AI models each focus on tasks like extraction or validation to deliver faster and more accurate results. And when you need clarity, just ask — the AI provides intuitive answers about your documents.

- Reduce manual effort and accelerate daily work with a true digital co-pilot.
- Slash error rates significantly, speed up processing times and mitigate risk.
- Harness AI trained compliantly on your own content, driving better decisions.

## Seamlessly integrate with your business ecosystem

Doxis connects the extracted information directly with your apps, like **SAP, Salesforce** and **Microsoft**, automatically updating files, initiating workflows and ensuring seamless data flow across systems — eliminating manual effort.

- Gain a 360° view of your customers, employees, patients and partners.
- Enhance your business apps with intelligent document processing capabilities.
- Leverage certified integrations with SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce and other leading apps.

## Easily configure content apps for faster time-to-value

Access Doxis Business Studio — a web-based, **no-code platform**— to easily create & customize apps tailored to your needs, or use pre-configured templates. Users become **citizen developers**, no programming required.

- Enjoy a low-code/no-code approach for easy workflow customizations.
- Explore a library of content apps for fast impact on operational efficiency.
- Drive seamless information flow, with apps in Doxis Business Studio easily plugging into other Doxis solutions.

## Deliver an unparalleled user experience

Doxis offers a simple and clean **user-friendly interface** designed to boost productivity and efficiency. Everything is at your fingertips, with **deep accessibility options** ensuring **everyone** can get the tools they need.

- Customize your team's workspace to match roles, use cases and focus topics.
- Get an overview of your team's tasks via highly-customizable dashboards.
- Enjoy Doxis your way with deep accessibility options.
